title: Section 1 — Terraformation levels
description: Terraformation progress indicators for the planet. Holds a single entry.

unitOxygenLevel.description: Oxygen level in raw units (Unity float — serialized with a trailing .0)

unitHeatLevel.description: Heat level in raw units (Unity float — serialized with a trailing .0)

unitPressureLevel.description: Atmospheric pressure level in raw units (Unity float — serialized with a trailing .0)

unitPlantsLevel.description: Plant level in raw units (Unity float — serialized with a trailing .0)

unitInsectsLevel.description: Insect level in raw units (Unity float — serialized with a trailing .0)

unitAnimalsLevel.description: Animal level in raw units (Unity float — serialized with a trailing .0)

unitPurificationLevel.description: Purification level in raw units (Unity float — serialized with a trailing .0). -1 is a sentinel value meaning purification is not unlocked yet.
